title: Welcome to Your Personal Flight Tracker
subtitle: Keep a detailed log of all your flights, explore your travel statistics, and visualize your journeys on a world map.
ai_body: Add new flights instantly with our integrated AI assistant. Just describe your flight and let AI handle the rest.

features.where_desc: Visualize all your flights on a world map.
features.what_desc: Get insights into your flight history and statistics.
features.which_desc: See your travel history and countries visited.
features.how_desc: Calculate total distance traveled across all flights and compare it with the circumference of the Earth, distance to the Moon, and Mars.
features.when_desc: View your flight history by year and check in which year, month, or day you flew the most.
features.detail_desc: See detailed flight information like departure/arrival airports, airline, and flight number.
